recipe.name: Pandan Pour
recipe.description: A fragrant, tropical riff on a Boulevardier with bittersweet herbal depth, grassy pandan aromas, toasted coconut undertones, and a subtle savory finish.
steps: Add Dewar's White Label, pandan rosoo, coconut Campari, and saline solution (if using) into a mixing glass filled with ice.
Stir smoothly for about 30 seconds until well-chilled and balanced in dilution.
Strain into a chilled rocks glass over a large clear ice cube.
Express fresh pandan oils over the surface and tuck the pandan garnish inside the glass.
recipe.serving: Stirred and served over a large block of ice in a rocks glass.
